name: jr-next-cost
description: What the next prompt costs before you send it, on /jrnextcost: the context it resends at the current model's price, read from a warm cache or written to a cold one, at API rates.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 5 for the default cache, 60 if your setup uses the one-hour cache.

inputPrice.title: Input price override ($ per million tokens)
inputPrice.description: 0 uses the built-in price of the session's model.

cacheReadPrice.title: Cache read price override ($ per million tokens)
cacheReadPrice.description: Used with the input override; 0 means a tenth of the input price.
